notes:
Account summary: NexusScale Analytics (Berlin HQ) builds revenue intelligence for mid-market SaaS. Primary need: conversational assistant for CS + vector search over customer docs and embeddings for similarity/rerank. They want to start on Hosted API to iterate quickly, then move to Dedicated for residency/throughput guarantees.

Key quotes / highlights:
- CTO: "Cannot send any PII or user content outside EU for customers in DE/FR" — strong data residency requirement.
- Head of Eng: "Latency budget for chat flows ~120-180ms p95; embeddings batch jobs ok to be async overnight; throughput target ~50 req/sec sustained for peak flows."

POC plan / tech asks:
- Phase 1 (Hosted): 2-week test in eu-central to measure end-to-end p95 for streaming chat and embedding latency. Use curated prompt set (attached drive deck) and sample traffic.
- Phase 2 (Dedicated pilot): 4-week reserved capacity in eu-central with canary routing, KV cache enabled, and quantized model variant for cost tests. Need clear SLA for failover to reserved NA region and cost for cross-region egress during failover.

Regional/routing discussion notes:
- They prefer single-region EU primary with automated failover to NA only for disaster recovery; legal team requires explicit controls so failover doesn’t route PII out of EU except under defined conditions.
- Interested in multi-region routing policy: route EU traffic to eu-central, allow read-only embeddings reindex jobs to run in NA off-hours if anonymized. Concerned about latency vs cost tradeoff for cross-region fallback (they want to avoid large latency spikes for user-facing chat).

Security / compliance asks:
- SSO (SAML) + SCIM; SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence needed; customer will require KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) and audit logging retention 7 years for specific enterprise customers. Data residency clause must guarantee EU processing and storage for EU-tenants.

Commercial / pricing notes:
- They are price sensitive but open to a moderate committed ARR for predictable latency. Asking for two pricing options: (a) Hosted with strict eu-region guaranteed endpoints & per-token pricing, (b) Dedicated with monthly reserved GPU pool pricing and clear unit economics on tokens/throughput. Need an itemized cost for egress and multi-region failover.

Next steps (short):
- Schedule scoping call for Dedicated pilot with infra + product owners (target week of 2026-02-27).
- Legal to review Redwood DPA and confirm wording on failover / cross-border processing.
- SE to share sample latency report from Hosted eu-central run + suggested batching/quantization configs (Manu).
